goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester auto-claimed a plot, watched cash come in, opened the SHOP and bought Dropper 2 there at step 14 (HUD showed 'Upgraded: Dropper 2'). It never walked onto a buy pad and never looked at the TOP TYCOONS board. Most of the session went on retrying the Gold Ore Buy button (which never fired) and on the Rebirth button and altar, so the new-player flow was only partly covered.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' for Gold Ore never fires and gives no feedback
bugs.evidence: Steps 2, 3, 7, 8 and 12 pressed ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_tier_gold.State ('Buy' at 739,744) by path and by text. Every time the result was done=False, 'button did NOT fire'. Cash was about 2.7K to 5K. No purchase happened and no 'not enough cash' or price message appeared. Other shop Buy buttons, such as Card_dropper2 at step 14, did fire. Either the button is clipped or unclickable in the scroll list, or an unaffordable item gives no feedback.

bugs.title: Tutorial is re-shown continuously
bugs.evidence: The tutorial_reshown counter reached 130 while tutorial_steps stayed at 4. The playtester saw it rise about once per second, including during shop and rebirth presses. It looks like a loop that re-triggers the tutorial and could clutter the UI.

bugs.title: Rebirth button gives 'Not ready to rebirth' feedback that confuses new players
bugs.evidence: At step 4 the REBIRTH $5000 button was reported as fired, yet the HUD showed 'Not ready to rebirth' (rebirth_denied reached 12). The rebirth went through at step 13 (rebirths=1), with the cost rising to $10.0K and the HUD showing 'REBIRTH x1.5!'. The playtester could not tell the exact requirement or why earlier presses were denied.

bugs.title: ProximityPrompts 'Button' TextButton is visible but does nothing when clicked
bugs.evidence: Steps 5, 10, 15 and 17 pressed ProximityPrompts.Prompt.TextButton ('Button' at 81,36). Each time the result was 'button did NOT fire'. The UI coverage report also lists it as pressed 4x and never fired. It may be a stray prompt UI element or a default proximity prompt button that is not clickable.

bugs.title: Shop ownership state disagrees with HUD and pads
bugs.evidence: The playtester reported Card_dropper3 showing 'Owned' while the HUD read 'Droppers: 2'. UpgradePad_dropper3 ('Dropper 3 | $150') was still listed as touchable, as were pads for other owned upgrades (mult1, tier_silver). Either the ownership state or the pad and HUD state is stale.
